common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can go straight onto the existing deadbolt without re-drilling or replacing the door — the Airtasker Ascot Vale VIC listing carries the request "Seeking a locksmith to install 1 smart lock in place of existing deadbolt".

Whether the incoming smart lock is compatible with, or can cleanly replace, the Gainsborough-style lockset already fitted — the Human Key Ascot Vale mobile locksmith page names "service and replace gainsborough style lock systems" as a local service line.

Keeping several doors keyed alike after a hardware change, and dealing with one lock that has already failed — the Airtasker Ascot Vale VIC listing asks for "6 x locks (so all locks/keys are the same if possible)" plus "1 x lock replaced for the circle lock (currently not functioning)".

Whether the smart lock will sit inside a single phone-app security setup alongside CCTV and a video doorbell rather than needing its own separate app — the Outsmart Solutions Ascot Vale page promises "remote access to CCTV video feeds and full control over smart locks on doors and windows" through "an app on your phone or tablet".
